body:
We used an offline VM running a copy of our Agie Classic Cut 2S machine control. We imported the nine-punch job. The control resolved nine ISO resources and threading points. The plot had 72 cutting blocks and separate cutting envelopes. The editor also exposed different resident quality values under the original quality names. See #2999 for the corrected import behavior.

All controller runs were offline. No physical cut was made.

Port onto the current frame. The new head is `13c980658`.

- Merge of `1e12c77a4` (#2981). The conflicts were in `posting_agie.rs`, `agie/mod.rs`, `agie/tests.rs`, the user guide and `crates/app/tests/agie_group.rs`. The frame side was taken in each file. The PR's change was then applied again on the frame in a new commit.
- The punch group limit is now 9 (`MAX_PUNCH_WORKS`) in the setup writer, the post and the app. Die groups stay at two openings.
- One `CCB030` quality object for all works (#2984). The per-work quality objects of the old body were not kept.
- The clear-band check covers every pair of works and names the two works.
- New goldens: `TRIO20.SBL/SBR`, `NINE20.SBL/SBR`, `TRIO201..203.ISO`. The PAIR20, DUODI20 and other existing goldens did not change.
- A new control import of TRIO20 and NINE20 on the emulated control: `CCB030[4]` on each work after TECCUT, `geen fouten`, 24 and 72 cut blocks, head-up transits only, and no overlap of the cutting envelopes. The PR body has the table.
- Gate: batch fallback, 1192 of 1193 steps ok, clippy ok. The one red step is the known #3774 test `rotary_verify`.
This PR goes back to draft. It takes the fixed head of #2981 and moves its test changes into the existing suites. The PR is flagged ready again when the gate is green.

Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review of the complete trial merge with upstream main `9046e1dc80d266f7dcc1ed04acd052e874bac81a`. The trial merge is `78428311c4601a9f80b2da642f7e95e850f5e85b`. Its first parent is the reviewed PR head. There is no earlier collaborator review to resolve.

The group checks every pair of works before publication. The count limit, separate resources, shared quality, and refusal of unowned models have passing tests.

**Results, run locally**

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: batch fallback; 1,204 steps passed, 0 failed, 0 stalled. This includes the debug builds and clippy with `-D warnings`.
- `example_catalog`: 39 passed, 4 ignored. `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed each.
- `golden_cl`: 34 passed. UI lib: 1,587 passed, 8 ignored. The new cutoff Apply/Undo test passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: all 11 light twins passed; 6 steps passed, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- Full heavy lanes were not run. Current upstream AGENTS.md requires no full heavy lane for this P6 PR.

**Extra suites run**

These readers ran again after quick because the diff adds golden files.

| Suite | Passed | Failed |
|---|---:|---:|
| camcraft-post lib | 146 | 0 |
| camcraft-post agie_cutoff_setup | 4 | 0 |
| camcraft-post agie_die_group_setup | 5 | 0 |
| camcraft-post agie_group_setup | 5 | 0 |
| camcraft-post agie_safe_setup | 8 | 0 |
| camcraft-app agie_native | 30 | 0 |
| camcraft-app agie_quality | 3 | 0 |

**Input mutations repeated in this review**

I ran separate temporary CLI cases. The valid trio and nine-work controls passed and wrote 5 and 11 files.

1. Put work 3 on work 1, with work 2 clear. The CLI failed as expected and named `TRIO201` and `TRIO203`. No output directory appeared.
2. Add a tenth work to the grid. The CLI failed as expected with the `2 to 9` diagnostic. No output directory appeared.

Both refusal assertions passed. These were input mutations; the source files were not edited.

**Goldens checked**

I read all 19 added golden files line by line. I checked the ISO coordinates, arc centres, work names, resources, holes, shared quality, and zero-step setup.

- App: `CIRCLE20.ISO`, `DUODI201.ISO`, `DUODI202.ISO`, `FINE20.ISO/SBL/SBR`, `RACE20.ISO`, and `TRIO201..203.ISO`.
- Post: `DUODI20.SBL/SBR`, `LOWER20.SBL`, `NINE20.SBL/SBR`, `PAIR20.SBL/SBR`, and `TRIO20.SBL/SBR`.

**Requested before merge**

1. `crates/app/src/operation/agie_die.rs:13`: Move the geometric opening match into camcraft-geometry. Keep the document selection lookup in app. This new module only compares loops, areas, bounds, and region differences after it reads `GenJob.contour_sel`. It does not read the ECS world, project file, command, MCP, or CLI. Current AGENTS.md requires this domain code in its owning crate.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wire_page.rs:235`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body for the two new cutoff controls. The body has no screenshot links. Keep the images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.
3. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:149`: Add `Process change: yes` to the PR body. This diff changes a process file. Do not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`; the merging session owns that change.
4. `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/agie-native/CIRCLE20.ISO:1`: Add a complete `Goldens moved` list to the PR body. List the 19 additions relative to upstream main, including the inherited stack changes. The current body only lists the new trio/grid files and calls the parent goldens unchanged.
5. `crates/app/tests/agie_quality.rs:1`: Give the required reason for each new top-level test binary, or put its tests in an existing suite. This also applies to `crates/post/tests/agie_cutoff_setup.rs`, `agie_die_group_setup.rs`, and `agie_group_setup.rs`. None is in ISOLATED or SLOW_BINARIES. The PR body gives no reason for these four binaries.

**Optional, non-blocking**

The diff grows two source files already above 400 lines: `mcp/job.rs` from 404 to 406, and `operation/wire_op.rs` from 494 to 496.

No controller run or physical cut was made in this review. The controller readings are the author's evidence.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Reply to the review of `13c980658` (comment 7129805821). New head: `db8a61aba`.

#2972, #2974, #2978 and #2979 are merged on main. This head merges the new #2981 head `7a97b0f57`, which merges `origin/main` `83e5e8a37`. The merge with the current main (`582981bfa`) is clean.

1. **Geometry in app** (`crates/app/src/operation/agie_die.rs:13`): fixed in #2981 (commit `afe9a7a82`) and merged here. The plate check and the opening match are now `camcraft_geometry::die_opening::check_die_plate` and `matching_opening`. The app keeps only the selection lookup (`GenJob.contour_sel`). The order of the checks and all diagnostics are unchanged. New tests: `die_opening::tests::a_plate_needs_the_stated_openings_inside_the_stock`, `die_opening::tests::a_closed_rim_matches_its_own_opening_only`.
2. **Screenshots** (`wire_page.rs:235`): the body has the before/after pair from the images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. With #2972 on main, this diff no longer changes the UI.
3. **`Process change: yes`** (`.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:149`): the skill change came with #2972 and is on main now. The diff of this head against main changes no process file, so the body has no `Process change` line. `PROCESS_VERSION` is not changed.
4. **Goldens moved** (`CIRCLE20.ISO:1`): the body lists the 11 additions relative to the current main, with reasons: DUODI201/202.ISO and DUODI20.SBL/SBR (from #2981), TRIO201..203.ISO, TRIO20.SBL/SBR and NINE20.SBL/SBR (this PR). The other 8 of the 19 files are on main now. No golden file of main changes. `Fixes #2980` is the last line of the body.
5. **New top-level test binaries** (`agie_quality.rs`, `agie_cutoff_setup.rs`, `agie_die_group_setup.rs`, `agie_group_setup.rs`): all four are modules of existing suites now. `agie_quality` is `agie_native::quality` (on main). The three post binaries are the modules `cutoff`, `group` and `die_group` of `agie_safe_setup`. The trio and grid cases of this PR moved with them into `agie_safe_setup/group.rs` and `agie_safe_setup/die_group.rs`. The suite has 22 tests (8 + 4 + 5 + 5), equal to the four old binaries. The PR adds no top-level test file. `group_count_tests.rs` is a lib test module.

Optional item (`mcp/job.rs` and `operation/wire_op.rs` above 400 lines): their growth came with #2972, which is merged. I did not split them in this PR.

Pinning tests: `agie_safe_setup` `group::trio_and_grid_files_match_their_goldens_with_one_quality`, `group::a_group_refuses_its_unqualified_inputs`, the `die_group::` tests, `agie::group_count_tests`, `die_opening::tests`, and the `agie_native` `group::` and `die_group::` tests.

Gate on `db8a61aba`: `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`, batch fallback: 1201 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (49.3 min). Strict clippy (`-D warnings`, all targets): clean.

Delta class (`cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 2992 --reviewed 13c980658`): NEW CODE. The new commits are `052e01afa` (a comment), merges of the stack branches and of main, and one hand-resolved merge `877007b02` (the move of the trio and grid tests into `agie_safe_setup/group.rs`, and one comment line in `agie_native/group.rs`).

Ready for a re-check.

Ready for the maintainer to merge. No PR blocker found.

This is a SAFETY-tier re-review. I read the complete current diff and checked the earlier findings first.

The local trial merge is `9223332ca4b619d153fc1934fe53c1a99b4022e4`, against upstream main `582981bfa92d208087eeed9e148dde045975a3c1`. Its first parent is the PR head. The merge is clean. I used upstream main's current AGENTS.md.

**Earlier findings**

1. Geometry in app: fixed by `afe9a7a82`, now on main. `agie_die.rs` keeps the document selection lookup. Geometry checks are in `camcraft_geometry::die_opening`.
2. UI screenshots: fixed. The body links the before/after images on the images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. This diff changes no UI code.
3. Process declaration: no longer applies. The skill change is on main. This diff changes no process file or PROCESS_VERSION.
4. Goldens moved: fixed. The body lists all additions. The four DUODI files are now on main. The seven remaining additions are listed below.
5. New test binaries: fixed. The tests are modules of `agie_safe_setup` and `agie_native`. This diff adds no top-level test binary.

The post checks every pair of works before it publishes the job. Each work has its own ISO resource and hole. All works use one quality object. The die limit stays at two openings.

**Results, run locally**

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 842 steps; 841 passed, one failed, zero stalled. The failed step is the baseline UI adapter failure below. Both app and post test builds passed.
- `example_catalog`: 41 passed, four ignored. `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work`: one passed each.
- `golden_cl`: 34 passed. App lib: 307 passed. Native post script suite: 11 passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: all 11 light twins passed; six steps, zero failed, zero stalled.
- Full heavy lanes did not run. Current AGENTS.md requires no full heavy lane for this P6 PR.

**Extra suites run**

I found the readers of both changed golden directories. I ran their suites again after the quick gate.

| Suite | Passed | Failed |
|---|---:|---:|
| camcraft-post lib | 147 | 0 |
| camcraft-post agie_safe_setup | 22 | 0 |
| camcraft-app agie_native | 33 | 0 |

The diff changes no importer. The additional importer suites do not apply.

**Baseline UI failure, not caused by this PR**

I ran the same step on bare upstream main `582981bfa92d208087eeed9e148dde045975a3c1` in this worktree. Then I restored the trial merge.

Command, from `crates/ui`: `cargo test -j 16 -p camcraft-ui --no-fail-fast --lib -- --test-threads=16`.

Both trees gave 1,589 passed, seven failed, and eight ignored. The same seven tests failed because this host exposes no graphics adapter:

- `egui_app::report_tests::a_kind_button_asks_the_shell_for_the_whole_window`
- `egui_app::report_tests::no_answer_copies_nothing`
- `egui_app::report_tests::the_answer_copies_the_picture_and_says_the_word`
- `egui_app::report_tests::the_door_opens_the_window_and_a_kind_button_files_the_url`
- `egui_app::report_tests::the_picture_is_still_copied_after_the_window_is_closed`
- `egui_app::report_tests::the_title_field_travels_into_the_url`
- `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`

The first six report:

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
```

The last reports `egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter`. The diagnostic says Metal found no adapters. I found no issue that tracks this host failure. This is a baseline failure, not a passing UI result.

**Input mutations repeated in this review**

I ran separate temporary CLI scripts with the built trial-merge CLI. No source file changed.

1. Valid trio and grid: green; five and eleven files written.
2. Put work 3 on work 1, with work 2 clear: red as expected. The error named `TRIO201` and `TRIO203`. No output directory appeared.
3. Add a tenth grid work: red as expected, with the `2 to 9` diagnostic. No output directory appeared.

Both mutation refusal assertions passed.

**Goldens checked**

I read all seven added files line by line: `TRIO201.ISO`, `TRIO202.ISO`, `TRIO203.ISO`, `TRIO20.SBL/SBR`, and `NINE20.SBL/SBR`. I checked coordinates, contour closure, hole positions, distinct resources, work order, the shared CCB030 quality, and zero-step setup records. No existing golden changes. All seven files appear under `Goldens moved` in the body.

**Requested before merge**

None. No new blocker or follow-up finding.

No controller run or physical cut was made in this review. The control readings are the author's evidence. The review worktree and branch remain in place to keep the build warm.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
